title: 第5章 顾余生你一定要争气第6章 太上元胎引玄妙酒葫芦
content_zh:
莫晚云的话，让身旁的长老微微一愣。
在他们看来，顾余生这样的少年，根本无足轻重，尽管他能够登青云梯入青云门，那又如何？刚才掌门吩咐陆展去负责接收入门弟子的事宜，暗示得很明显了吧？
在绝大多数人心中，顾白是青云门之耻，他的儿子，虽然不至于被赶出去，但肯定会被冷落，等过了招收弟子这股风，随便找个理由把那少年踢出山门即可。
可现在，这小子倒是好运气。
居然有大儒的孙女罩着，别看莫晚云还小，可她背后的势力，是一座高不可攀的山，青云门若不是仗着昔日三大圣地创建的余晖，只怕莫先生孙女这样的小姑娘，跺一跺脚，青萍山也经受不起折腾的。
再加上这数百年来，因为一些原因，青云门早就与三大圣地失去了联系，只有一座镇妖碑还昭显着昔日的辉煌。
莫晚云这样天资出众的人，青云门做梦都想要收为弟子，只不过，如今偏偏扯上顾余生。
宛如好好的一锅粥，里面多出一颗老鼠屎。
有些难受。
不过有吃的，总是要抢的。
六峰峰主和长老一个比一个精明，一名衣服上印着丹鹤的老者捻须道：“掌门师兄，让莫小姐入我丹霞峰吧，她乃无垢之体，学习丹道，定然水到渠成，至于那顾白之子入我丹霞峰，只需负责一些炼丹杂事，也不用下山斩妖，反正丢人也丢不到门外去。”
莫晚云本来听见炼丹二字，颇有些兴趣，可后来听丹霞峰主赵三钱编排顾余生，摇头道：“我不炼丹！”
赵三钱面色一僵。
余光狠狠的瞄向顾余生，这小姑娘多好的一个苗子，偏要搭上你这个拖油瓶，晦气！
立即有一身材丰腴的道姑手持拂尘，开口对莫晚云说：“莫小姐，你可以入我落尘峰，我传你七情大道，以你的明心通体，可以直接跨过元胎，开脉，煅骨，凝魂四大修武境界，不出七年，即可进入合道之境，可力敌大妖！”
“嗯？”
落霞峰道姑何红念的话刚一说完，就连大儒莫先生也有些意外。
修行之路，自然有境界高低之分，从低到高为：元胎，开脉，煅骨，凝魂，合道，归一，金丹……
但由于人族修三千大道，在归一境后，修行的方向各不相同。
有大儒，有圣僧，有道人。

故而修行者习惯以第七境，第八境，第九境来提及修为高深之人。
前四境为武道境，是习武修炼的极致，很多人穷其一生都无法进入第四境，青云门是个小派，如今的掌门，也不过才是归一境而已，想要斩一只大妖王都有些困难，而这七情大道，竟然只要七年即可入第五境。
“青云门竟然有七情大道作为传承？”
何红念开口道：“回禀前辈，这七情大道，是当年蓬莱圣地的一位化神境仙子所留，可惜传承并不完整，但莫小姐若能修行圆满，可以有机会入圣地……”
“原来如此。”
莫凡尘略作沉吟，七情大道虽好，可一旦入此道，那这般活泼可爱的孙女，以后可能就会变成冰冷冷的性子。
掌门玄机子将诸位峰主和长老的表情看在眼里，他思索片刻，已有对策，咳嗽一声，对众人道：
“以我等的身份，还无法做莫小姐的恩师，只可授业，这样罢，莫小姐身份不凡，体质特殊，修行之路事半功倍，六峰之主以及长老，皆可教莫小姐，当然，我也可以指点莫小姐修行，莫前辈，你看这样可行？”
“善。”
老者只言一字。
他虽然常年与圣书为伴，是书呆子，可读书明心知人，众人的心思他早就洞若观火，明白得很，博学也好，致一也罢，说来说去，无非是青云门内部在权衡利弊，六峰可学，未必都要学。
玄机子不愧是当掌门的。
content_en:
Mo Wanyun's words made the elder beside him slightly stunned.
In their view, a young man like Gu Yusheng was of no importance at all. Even though he could climb the Qingyun Ladder and enter the Qingyun Sect, so what? Just now, the leader asked Lu Zhan to take charge of accepting new disciples. Was that an obvious hint?
In the hearts of most people, Gu Bai is the disgrace of the Qingyun Sect. Although his son will not be kicked out, he will definitely be left out. Once the trend of recruiting disciples is over, he can just find any reason to kick the young man out of the sect.
But now, this kid is lucky.
She is actually being protected by the granddaughter of a great scholar. Even though Mo Wanyun is still young, the power behind her is an unattainable mountain. If Qingyun Sect had not relied on the afterglow of the establishment of the three holy places in the past, even a little girl like Mr. Mo's granddaughter would not be able to withstand the torment of Qingping Mountain.
In addition, over the past hundreds of years, due to some reasons, Qingyun Sect has long lost contact with the three holy places, and only one demon-suppressing monument still shows its former glory.
The Qingyun Sect had always dreamed of accepting a talented person like Mo Wanyun as a disciple, but now it happened to involve Gu Yusheng.
It's like a good pot of porridge with an extra mouse dropping in it.
Somewhat uncomfortable.
But if there is food, you always have to grab it.
The masters and elders of the Six Peaks were more shrewd than the other. An old man with a red crane printed on his clothes twirled his beard and said, "Brother, please let Miss Mo enter our Danxia Peak. She is a Wushou body, and learning alchemy will be a matter of course. As for Gu Bai's son who joins our Danxia Peak, he only has to be responsible for some alchemy chores, and does not need to go down the mountain to slay demons. Anyway, he can't be thrown out of the door if he is embarrassed."
Mo Wanyun originally heard the word alchemy and was quite interested, but then he heard Danxia Peak Master Zhao Sanqian arrange Gu Yusheng, shook his head and said: "I don't do alchemy!"
Zhao Sanqian's expression froze.
He glanced at Gu Yusheng fiercely out of the corner of his eye. What a good young girl this girl is, but she has to get caught up with a dragster like you. What a bad luck!
Immediately, a plump Taoist nun held a fly whisk and said to Mo Wanyun: "Miss Mo, you can enter my Luochen Peak, and I will teach you the Seven Emotions Road. With your clear mind, you can directly cross the four realms of Yuan Fei, open veins, forge bones, and condense souls. In less than seven years, you can enter the realm of Hedao and be able to defeat the great demon!"
"Huh?"
As soon as Luoxia Peak Taoist Aunt He Hongnian finished speaking, even Mr. Mo was a little surprised.
The path of cultivation naturally has different levels. From low to high they are: Yuan Fei, Opening Veins, Forging Bones, Condensing Soul, Harmonizing Dao, Unifying, Golden Pill...
However, since the human race cultivates the three thousand avenues, after returning to the unified realm, the directions of cultivation are different.
There are great Confucians, there are saintly monks, and there are Taoists.
Therefore, practitioners are accustomed to refer to people with advanced cultivation levels as the seventh realm, the eighth realm, and the ninth realm.
The first four realms are the martial arts realm, which is the ultimate level of martial arts training. Many people spend their whole lives unable to enter the fourth realm. Qingyun Sect is a small sect, and the current leader is only at the Guiyi realm. It is difficult to kill a big demon king. However, with the Seven Emotions Avenue, it only takes seven years to enter the fifth realm.
"Qingyun Sect actually has Seven Emotions Avenue as its inheritance?"
He Hongnian said: "Reporting back to my predecessors, this Seven Emotions Avenue was left by a fairy who lived in Penglai Holy Land. Unfortunately, the inheritance is not complete, but if Miss Mo can practice to perfection, she will have the opportunity to enter the Holy Land..."
"That's it."
Mo Fanchen pondered for a moment, although the Seven Emotions Path is good, once she enters this path, such a lively and lovely granddaughter may become cold-tempered in the future.
The head Xuanjizi saw the expressions of the peak masters and elders in his eyes. He thought for a moment and had a countermeasure. He coughed and said to everyone:
"With my status, I can't be Miss Mo's mentor. I can only teach her. In this case, Miss Mo's status is extraordinary and her physique is special. Her cultivation path will be easier with half the effort. The masters and elders of the Six Peaks can teach Miss Mo. Of course, I can also teach her.To guide Miss Mo in her practice, Senior Mo, do you think this is feasible? "
"Good. "
The old man said only one word.
Although he has been with holy books all year round and is a bookworm, he can read clearly and know people's thoughts. He has long been able to understand people's thoughts very clearly. Whether he is knowledgeable or consistent, all he says is that the Qingyun Sect is weighing the pros and cons. Six peaks can be learned, but not all of them may be learned.
Xuanjizi deserves to be the leader.
